description: What one stage holds of one artifact, state/<stage>/<artifact>.yaml, written by GORA only (ADR-026 section 6); metadata names the stage and the artifact of its path. Beyond what this schema checks, GORA refuses a version that is not the final version X.Y.Z in prod, or not the rc version X.Y.Z-rc in any other stage. An optional field is absent or holds a value, never null, and a mapping or list it holds is never empty. Top-level fields appear in the order apiVersion, kind, metadata, spec, writtenBy.

writtenBy.description: must be a SemVer 2.0.0 version without build metadata: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with an optional -PRERELEASE, no leading zeros, no +BUILD, not ending in .lock (a version is also a git tag and part of a branch name), at most 128 characters
